name: agy-readable
description: Rewrite Claude's hard-to-read Korean answers into plain Korean with agy (Antigravity CLI), on your own Antigravity sign-in. Code, numbers, paths and links are checked to come through unchanged; otherwise the original is shown.

model.title: agy model
model.description: Model agy rewrites with (`agy models` lists them). High thinks about 10 s longer per answer for no visible gain on this task.

timeout.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: How long to wait for agy before showing the original answer instead.

notes.title: Show skip notes
notes.description: Add one line under an answer shown unrewritten, saying why (timeout, agy error, a number that changed).
